##### Project general facts

Damac Bay by Cavalli is a premium waterfront residential development by DAMAC Properties in collaboration with Cavalli. The project comprises three architecturally striking towers rising between 30 and 40 storeys, designed to deliver an exclusive branded waterfront lifestyle. Positioned in one of Dubai’s most dynamic coastal destinations, the development offers a contemporary residential concept focused on luxury living, sea views, and proximity to major leisure and marina attractions.

The project is designed to offer a high-end coastal lifestyle, with residents benefiting from an exclusive waterfront setting in Dubai Harbour. The development’s location provides immediate access to marina promenades, beach areas, and leisure destinations, creating a resort-style environment. The overall concept emphasizes luxury seaside living combined with urban connectivity and branded Cavalli design influence.

The interiors feature high-quality residential finishing, including porcelain tiled flooring, painted plastered walls with selected accent walls, and partially finished gypsum ceilings. Bathrooms are fitted with porcelain or ceramic tiles, modern sanitary ware, mirrors, and vanities with under-counter storage. Kitchens are fully fitted and include refrigerator, cooker, hob, and washing machine, along with tiled flooring and finished countertops with backsplash details. Residences are delivered unfurnished, maintaining a clean, modern standard suitable for personalization.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Harbour is a premier waterfront destination in Dubai, known for its luxurious lifestyle, stunning skyline, and vibrant atmosphere. Dubai Harbour is a meticulously planned urban district nestled along the coast of the Persian Gulf. It's characterized by sleek skyscrapers, contemporary architecture, and a bustling marina filled with luxury yachts. The area offers an unparalleled blend of residential, commercial, and leisure spaces, making it a sought-after location for both residents and visitors.

The area is well-connected with easy access to major highways, public transportation, and proximity to key landmarks and business districts. The area offers easy access to pristine beaches such as Jumeirah Beach and Jumeirah Beach Residence (JBR) public beach. Residents can enjoy sunbathing, swimming, water sports and leisurely strolls along the sandy shore just minutes from Dubai Marina.

Overall, Dubai Harbour offers residents and visitors an unparalleled lifestyle that combines luxury living, convenience and proximity to a wealth of amenities, attractions and leisure opportunities..
